tool_input.command: S=plugins/dev-graph/scripts; R=$PWD; python3 $S/validate-graph-schema.py --help 2>&1 | head -30; python3 $S/validate-source-lineage.py --help 2>&1|head -30; python3 $S/resolve-repo-context.py --help 2>&1 | head -30

tool_result_content:
usage: validate-graph-schema.py [-h] --graph GRAPH [--repo-root REPO_ROOT]
                                [--require-canonical-envelope]
                                [--strict-artifact-readiness]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --graph GRAPH         graph JSON path、または '-' で stdin から preview graph を読む
                        (dry-run 用)
  --repo-root REPO_ROOT
  --require-canonical-envelope
                        入力が canonical store でなくても envelope を必須にする (監査経路用)
  --strict-artifact-readiness
                        artifact 本文の heading_missing/placeholder_only_section
                        を violation に格上げする (既定は artifact_readiness へ報告するだけ)
usage: validate-source-lineage.py [-h] --repo-root REPO_ROOT [--graph GRAPH]
                                  [--node-id NODE_ID]

system-spec-harness 由来の source_lineage を検査する (読取りのみ)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --repo-root REPO_ROOT
  --graph GRAPH         repo 相対または絶対 path (既定: .dev-graph/state/graph.json)
  --node-id NODE_ID     検査対象を絞る graph_node_id (複数可)
usage: resolve-repo-context.py [-h] [--repo-root REPO_ROOT] [--config CONFIG]
                               [--mode {read,write}]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --repo-root REPO_ROOT
  --config CONFIG
  --mode {read,write}
